mechanics.body_shape: a reset. The same operation seven times over: advance an element's current word to start+35 and zero the 35 bytes at start. Once on the element at self+0x4d8, then six times on elements walked at a stride of 20 bytes from self+0x50c, with a dword of a six-dword run at self+0x4f0 zeroed per iteration and one dword at self+0x4ec zeroed once before the loop.

the_operation.if_size_at_least_35: the body moves the current word ITSELF: dest = start+35, a zero-length memcpy(dest, current, 0), and current += (dest - current) in wrapping 32-bit arithmetic
the_operation.else: the body calls 0x005151b0 with (receiver = &start_word, current_address, 35 - (current - start), &zero_byte) and writes NOTHING to the current word; advancing it is the callee's, which its own bytes show at 0x00515291 and 0x005153cc
the_operation.both_arms: then 35 bytes at start are zeroed, one byte at a time, from a start word re-read on every iteration

mechanics.address_words: the two words of an element hold ADDRESSES, not values: 0x00586756 MOV byte ptr [EAX + ECX * 1],0x0 uses the loaded word as a base with no displacement added, and 0x00586744 PUSH EBX pushes one straight into memcpy's destination slot. One level of indirection each; the model converts at exactly one place (the at() accessor) and the test plants a decoy at the pointee of the pointee.

unresolved_questions: RETURN SEMANTICS is a WARN by construction and this package does not pretend otherwise. The canonical ABI record's return_semantics is the machine phrase 'integral_in_EAX', so no C++ declaration can agree with it as a string and the dimension WARNs whatever is written. This package took section 7.1's option (a) and declared `int`, which is true of the listing (EAX = 0x23 at the single reachable return) and is the width evidence_returns.classify computes on its own (WIDTH_4_IN_EAX). It did NOT take option (b) and declare void, because the bytes do produce a four-byte value and void would be a claim the machine contradicts. It did NOT invent a typedef named after the phrase, which would be a validator hack. If a reviewer prefers void, the change is one token and the two alternatives are argued above.

EVIDENCE COVERAGE is a WARN because 10 of the 17 static categories in the pack are available: callees_dependencies, callers_dependencies, contradictions, external_callees, globals, semantic_hypotheses and types all report availability 'unavailable' / evidence_state 'MISSING'. This is a property of the committed evidence pack and is not fixable from a source file. Note that the missing 'types' category is why the FIELDS/OFFSETS arm falls back to the receiver's displacement bounds and why no member could be named even had one been wanted.

What 0x005151b0 does internally. Its call boundary is reconstructed from the four stack words, the ECX receiver and the callee's own 295 instructions, and the word 'buffer' is licensed by those bytes -- but its grow-and-copy internals, its allocator protocol through 0x0042dee0 and its fill semantics beyond 'advance the current word and zero up to start+35' are NOT reconstructed. This body is not required to depend on any of it, and the model test proves it does not: with a completely passive observer that writes nothing, the reconstruction's observable result is unchanged.

The identity of the dword at self+0x4ec and of the six dwords at self+0x4f0 + 4k. This body zeroes them (0x00586766 and 0x00586786) and never reads them on any path, so nothing here establishes what they are. Their stride of four and count of six are fixed; their meaning is not.

Whether the 20-byte walker stride is a 16-byte element plus 4 bytes of padding, a 12-byte start/current/capacity triple plus 8 bytes, or something else. The stride and the two word displacements are fixed by 0x005867e2 and 0x0058678f/0x00586792; the element's size is not. 0x005151b0 reads its receiver's +0x0c (0x00515461), which puts a floor of sixteen bytes under it, and the remaining four are unaccounted for.

The class this entry point belongs to. The 29-word run at 0x013f57f8 is confirmed to be a class dispatch table by the sole DATA xref and by six of its slots being named independently in this target's analogue record, and this body is its word index 20. No class name, no slot meaning and no member identity is claimed, and none is derivable from this body: it contains no indirect transfer and never reads its receiver's +0x00.

The object's real size. This body writes no byte above self+0x573 and reads no byte of the receiver outside 0x4d8..0x573. The model test's fixture is 0x600 bytes so that the thunk's source argument, which is whatever the current word holds, can be pointed anywhere without leaving the fixture. 0x574 is a lower bound on the layout, not a claim about it.

Which side pops the arguments of 0x005151b0. The original is 0x005155ed RET 0xc, callee-owned twelve bytes; the GCC spelling of __thiscall used in this package's header is caller-owned. The model reproduces the RECEIVER REGISTER and the ARGUMENT ORDER and not the cleanup side, because the two cannot both be reproduced through one GCC attribute. The cdecl thunk's balance IS measured (ESP sampled around the call), and the observations' own frame addresses are compared with the caller's. This is stated in the header rather than hidden.

The reload of the start word in the two zeroing loops (0x00586754 and 0x005867d1) is reproduced in the source but is not independently observable: no instruction between the reload and the store can change that word on either path, so the test asserts the effect and not the reload. Stating it as a note rather than a test is deliberate.

Two constants in sw2_00586700_model_test.cpp were unused: (1) k_receiver_lo, declared `std::uint8_t* const volatile k_receiver_lo = nullptr` with the comment 'unused sentinel, see below' and no 'below' -- a null sentinel that documented the receiver byte run's LOWER BOUND, the bound the I2 check (the value byte handed to 0x005151b0 is not a receiver address) was already computing inline off g_receiver_base; and (2) kWindowCanary = kWindowStride - kBufBytes, 29, the POISONED GUARD BAND after each 35-byte window. NEITHER WAS DELETED, because neither fact is gone, and the second was not merely unused: the case that swept the band had been left asserting the band only by byte diff, so the band was unguarded in the one respect that matters. The fix is to USE both, in a new guard-band case (P) that is machine-grounded: the body reaches the receiver only through the register 0x00586705 MOV EBP,ECX loads out of ECX and reaches the buffers only through the addresses its words hold, so the receiver run and the backing run are each ONE BOUNDED OBJECT and 'outside its window' is a claim about an address range. k_receiver_lo is now that run's live lower bound -- it is published by run(), and inside_receiver_run() and the pre-existing I2 check are stated against it, so the dead sentinel became the bounds predicate the bounds checks use; g_receiver_base was folded into it rather than left beside it. kWindowCanary is now the width of the band sweep itself, in window_band_intact(), so the constant that says how wide the poisoned band is also says where the sweep stops and the two cannot disagree. The new case asserts, BY VALUE rather than by diff because a diff cannot see a write of the value a byte already held: P1/P3 that all 363 band words of the 384-word receiver run still hold the bulk pattern before and after the body runs (the precondition no other case established, and without which T3's byte diff, D1 and E5 are all vacuous), P2/P4 that all 29 canary bytes of all EIGHT windows survive, P5 that the body's whole reach 0x4d8..0x573 is inside the receiver run the band is stated in, P5b that the band is 363 of 384 words so the sweep cannot be vacuous, and P6 that each element's 35-byte window is inside the backing run. Fixture::offset_is_anchored() is the twenty-one words the body may write (1 + 6 + 2*7) and is deliberately word-exact rather than a range: the fifteen words BETWEEN the walker elements' pairs (0x510..0x51b and so on) hold the bulk pattern, are never written by this body, and are precisely where a store one word too high lands -- a range-shaped set skipped them and a mutant that stored into that gap was caught only by T3, not by the band. NO EXISTING ASSERTION WAS REMOVED, WEAKENED OR REORDERED: I2 is the same range test with the same bound under a name, the per-window canary loop in the A1 case is untouched, and every case T1..N1 still runs. The reconstruction and the header are BYTE-IDENTICAL to what the implementing worker left: the seven times repeated reset is still the unsigned JNC at both sites, the wrapping ADD to start+35 on the fast arm, the delegation to 0x005151b0 with nothing written to the CURRENT word on the slow arm, and the span still names ZERO struct members and still carries exactly three hex literals, {0x4d8, 0x4ec, 0x50c}, the three in the receiver record's bounds. Coverage went UP, not sideways: calls in main 17 -> 18, check() call sites 94 -> 105, checks executed 997 -> 1028, and the falsification measurement was re-run from scratch -- 26 mutations of the reconstruction, one at a time, compiled against the test with verify_constants() neutered, 26 of 26 killed by the behavioural cases, plus 7 new out-of-band (P) mutants of which 7 of 7 are killed and 4 of them by the new P assertions specifically.
